plugins.name: CDRomance
plugins.author: MoveWeight
plugins.description: BROWSER-ASSISTED. Anonymous plugin HTTP is blocked by Cloudflare, but ROMarr Capture can index a detail page the operator opens normally in Brave/Chromium.
plugins.terms: The standalone provider fetches and redistributes nothing. Browser capture indexes metadata only from a page the operator opened and grants no rights to download or redistribute the site's files.
plugins.comments: Every anonymous path, including robots.txt, returns a Cloudflare managed challenge, so there is intentionally no standalone RPP manifest. This is no longer treated as a dead end: ROMarr Capture has a preview-first CDRomance detail adapter that reads the already-rendered page without crawling or solving the challenge. Its selectors still need verification in an operator session; missing title/platform/size is an adapter defect, not proof that the source is impossible.
